project.title_en: Fake Cream, Real Victims: Influencer Ads and Consumer Rights in Kurdistan

cards.meaning_en: A cream that famous faces advertised / thousands of people bought it
broll: Opening shot (reused as the loop shot at the end): close-up of a hand reaching for a cream jar, slow push-in, shallow focus. Use the HOKAR clip of a man holding up a jar, or film a generic unbranded jar yourself.
Phone screen scrolling a social feed; every face and brand on the screen is blurred.
cards.sfx: Low sub-bass hit on frame 1; soft tick as each line appears.

cards.meaning_en: Now a viral video says / the 'Almas' cream is fake
broll: HOKAR reel: the presenter speaking into a microphone on an Erbil street at night. Original audio muted.
cards.sfx: Short reverse-cymbal swell into the card.

cards.meaning_en: Price per jar / 25,000 to 35,000 dinars / according to the video
broll: HOKAR clip: men holding up jars of the cream. Slow push-in on one jar; darken the background so the number reads.
cards.sfx: A single dull impact on the number line. No cartoon or cash-register sounds.

cards.meaning_en: The video claims: / it was made in Erbil / and even its sticker is fake

kmr: û etîketa wî jî sexte ye

broll: Wide night shot of an Erbil street (own footage or HOKAR background).
Close-up of a jar label from the HOKAR clip; do not add any 'FAKE' stamp or red X: the claim is unconfirmed.
cards.sfx: Whoosh + low boom on the white flash before this card.

cards.meaning_en: Some of the advertisers / swore on the Quran / that it works
broll: HOKAR clips of the advertisers holding the jars. No zooms, freeze-frames or mocking effects on faces; keep it respectful.
cards.sfx: Music drops to the pulse only for this card.

cards.meaning_en: These claims have not yet been / confirmed by a lab result / or a court ruling

ckb: بە ئەنجامی تاقیگە یان بڕیاری دادگا

broll: Generic laboratory glassware or a courthouse exterior, marked 'illustrative' in small text (see labels.illustrative).
cards.sfx: Hold the music steady; no hit. This card must feel calm and factual.

cards.meaning_en: In a market inspection, Kurdistan24 / showed skin-whitening pills
broll: Kurdistan24 reel: market stalls, uniformed security officers, shelves of cosmetics and supplements.
cards.sfx: Whoosh + low boom on the white flash before this card; light street ambience under the music.

cards.meaning_en: Rasul Abdulkhaliq warned: / they can cause serious harm / even cancer
broll: Kurdistan24 reel: the speaker holding up the pink bottle of whitening pills.
cards.sfx: Music ducks 4 dB under this card.
cards.editor_note: Show his name only. His official title is not stated in the clips; add it only after confirming it.

cards.meaning_en: Medicine should only be sold / in licensed pharmacies / not on market stalls
broll: Kurdistan24: open market stall with medicine and supplements.
Contrast cut: a licensed pharmacy counter (own footage), green cross sign.
cards.sfx: Hard cut on the beat between the stall and the pharmacy.

cards.meaning_en: A Ministry of Health sticker / does not mean / it entered the market legally
broll: Macro close-up of a product sticker on a box (Kurdistan24 footage or a generic box you film; blur any real brand).
cards.sfx: Single soft impact on 'does not mean'.

cards.meaning_en: Fakhir Hariri responded: / "Whether the sticker is real or fake / is not my problem"
broll: Fakhir Hariri's own clarification video, speaking to camera. Use it unaltered: no slow-motion, filters, zooms or sound effects on him.
cards.sfx: Music drops to a low drone; no hits during his two cards (fairness).

cards.meaning_en: He said half of Kurdistan's artists / advertised it / and he deceived no one
broll: Continue the same Hariri clip; one cut to a second moment of the same video.
cards.sfx: Low drone continues.

cards.meaning_en: Iraq's Consumer Protection Law / No. 1 of 2010 / also covers advertisers
broll: Screen capture of the official Arabic law text (UN ESCWA PDF), slow scroll, with the definition of 'advertiser' (Article 1) softly highlighted.
cards.sfx: Whoosh + low boom on the white flash; music starts its slow build here.

cards.meaning_en: Article 7: / the advertiser must check the product's details / before advertising it
broll: Law PDF: Article 7 highlighted line by line in sync with the words.
cards.sfx: Soft tick per line.

cards.meaning_en: Article 9: / fraud and deception are banned / for sellers and advertisers
broll: Law PDF: Article 9 highlighted.
cards.sfx: Soft tick per line.

cards.meaning_en: Article 12: / at least 3 months in prison / and/or a fine of at least 1 million dinars

ar: و/أو غرامة لا تقل عن مليون دينار

broll: Dark, slow push-in on a judge's gavel or an empty courtroom (stock), marked 'illustrative'.
cards.sfx: Deep impact on the prison line; music peaks here.

cards.meaning_en: A sticker / is not a safety test
broll: Macro, own footage: a sticker slowly peeled off a plain, unbranded jar. Black-and-white grade.
cards.sfx: White flash + boom, then near-silence: one low piano note.

cards.meaning_en: Selling people's trust for money / without checking / is a betrayal of followers
broll: Dwin dark-green background; behind it, very blurred, a phone showing a like counter rising.
cards.sfx: Firm low string swell.

cards.meaning_en: We condemn everyone / who misleads people / with ads they never checked

kmr: bi reklamên bê kontrol xelkê dixapînin

broll: Same Dwin background, Dwin logo watermark centred at 8% opacity behind the text.
cards.sfx: Strings hold; one deep hit on the last word, then music turns to the hopeful cue.

cards.meaning_en: Medicines and medicated creams / buy them only from licensed pharmacies
broll: Own footage: a pharmacist handing a boxed medicine across the counter; warm, bright grade.
cards.sfx: Whoosh on the white flash; hopeful piano + light percussion starts.

cards.meaning_en: A celebrity ad / is still an ad / not proof that it is safe
broll: A thumb scrolling past a generic ad on a phone (mock ad with an invented product; no real person).
cards.sfx: Soft swipe sound on the scroll.

cards.meaning_en: Keep the receipt, the packaging / and a screenshot of the ad
broll: Own footage: hands photographing a receipt and a product box with a phone.
cards.sfx: Camera-shutter click synced to the phone tap.

cards.meaning_en: If it harmed you / complain to the health authorities / the law covers seller and advertiser

kmr: gilî bike li ba rayedarên tenduristiyê

broll: Exterior of a health directorate building (own footage) or a hand filling in a complaint form.
cards.sfx: Music lifts slightly.

cards.meaning_en: Before you buy / ask: who checked it?
broll: Return to the opening shot (hand reaching for the jar), the hand stops and pulls back. Ends on the exact first frame of C01 so the reel loops.
cards.sfx: Music resolves on the final chord; hard stop on the last frame.

cards.meaning_en: Sources: HOKAR · Kurdistan24 · Fakhir Hariri's page · Consumer Protection Law No. 1 of 2010
broll: Dwin dark-green end background.
cards.sfx: Silence or the last chord's tail.

cards.meaning_en: End card: Dwin logo + channel name + tagline

ckb: دەنگی کورد، بە ناسنامە و باوەڕمانەوە
kmr: Dengê Kurdan, bi nasname û baweriya me

broll: Dwin logo animates in (scale 96% → 100%, 0.4 s), dark-green background, gold shield.
cards.sfx: Dwin sound logo if you have one; otherwise silence.

facts.claim_en: The Almas cream was promoted by Fakhir Hariri and other well-known Kurdish personalities; a viral video says it is fake and that thousands of buyers were misled.
Jars sold for 25,000–35,000 Iraqi dinars each.
The cream was being produced locally in Erbil, not by an established manufacturer.
Some of the artists who promoted it swore on the Quran that it worked.
The claims of fakeness, local production and forged sticker are not confirmed by an official lab result or court ruling in the material reviewed.
facts.status: verified statement of what is NOT confirmed

facts.claim_en: Kurdistan24 reported on a market inspection/crackdown on whitening medicines, with security officers present.
Rasul Abdulkhaliq warned the whitening product can cause serious harm, including cancer.
Such medicines should only be sold through licensed pharmacies; these were on open stalls without a permit.
A Ministry of Health sticker does not mean the product entered the market legally.
Fakhir Hariri said whether the sticker is genuine or forged is not his problem; checking it is the ministry's job.
Hariri said half of Kurdistan's artists advertised the product and that he deceived no one.
Iraq Consumer Protection Law No. 1 of 2010 defines 'advertiser' (Art. 1) and applies to anyone who makes, sells, markets, imports or advertises (Art. 3).
Article 7 requires suppliers and advertisers to verify product data before selling or advertising, and bars promoting non-compliant products.
Article 9 bans suppliers and advertisers from fraud, deception and misleading acts.

Violating Article 9 is punishable by at least 3 months in prison and/or a fine of at least 1,000,000 dinars. This is Article 12 of the law (the source article said Article 10; Article 10 covers council staff).
facts.status: verified against official text; CORRECTED article number

facts.claim_en: Dwin's editorial position: a sticker is not a safety test; promoting products without checking them betrays followers' trust; Dwin condemns anyone who misleads people with unchecked ads.
facts.status: OPINION — must appear only in Style C cards with the 'Dwin's position' tag

facts.claim_en: Consumer advice: buy medicines only from licensed pharmacies; a celebrity ad is not evidence; keep receipt, packaging and screenshots; report harm.
Consumers can claim compensation through the courts (Art. 6).
